main_text.p: Calvini doctrinae fidem adhibent tanquam orthodoxae, hoc est (Papistico Bellarmini idomate) Calviniftas, pietatis studio erga Sanctiffimum, Deum gloriae & majestatis, reliquias imaginesque de medio removere: sed nullam in cuiusquam Sancti contumeliam, nedum cum immani Sanctorum omnium contemtu, quem Bellarminus criminatur. Etenim quod ait corpora illorum a Calviniftis ubique effodi, flammis absumi, in profluentem abjici: calumniatoris maledictum est, in immerentes conjectum, in ipsos justius retorquendum. Gloss. in provinc. confit.*amplius qua-draginta annis quievissent, mandato Papae exhu-matis, combustis, & cineribus eorundem in proxi-mum amnem projectis, utinamque non in corpo-ra etiam vivorum, primo Iohannis Huffi, tum Hieronymi Pragensis, itidem, immaniore per-fidia, crudelitate, sacrilegio, graffati effent. Angl. tit. de magistris, c. 3.Verum Calviniftas cuiusquam Sancti mortui corpus sic tractaffe, quam impudens sit mendacium, nullius prorfus teftis, non modo non idonei, autori-tate comprobatum: patebit Huius libri cap. 9.suo loco. Interim, Æn. Sylv. hist. Bohem. cap. 36.quum PapistaeMiffal. Rom. reformat. à Pio V. tit. de ritu serv. in cele-br. Miff. incensum adoleverint, & usque ad hunc diem adoleant, primo cruci, deinde re-liquiis, postea imaginibus: Calvini doctrinam de his tollendis sanctam esse oftendit Ezekiae exemplum, testimonio Spiritus sancti comproba-tum. Namque ferpens aeneus à Mose, juffu Dei, ad populum à morte liberandum, factus est: & signum erat crucis, neque crucis fo-lum, fed etiam Christi crucifixi; eoque, ex2. page.notes: Marginal notes are small and partly uneven; the placement of several note letters beside their lines is approximate. The star mark in the text ("*VViclefi" and "*amplius") is read as printed, but the two star notes in the margin are uncertain. The note beginning "Obiit" is partly unclear. The word after "patebit" reads "luo" in the scan, probably a long-s form of "suo". "Huffi" and "tractaffe" are as printed. The notes "Nu m.21 8." (f) and "loh.3.14." (g) are at the end of the text and are not transcribed beside their words, because their marks are not clear enough in the scan.
